content.primaryText: Still on hold for a callback that may never come? Home projects shouldn't start with phone tag. AllignX connects you with trusted, vetted professionals in your neighborhood.
content.headline: Still waiting on that callback?
content.visualBrief: Open on a tight shot of a smartphone screen showing a call timer frozen mid-hold — no contractor name visible, just the elapsed time ticking. Pull back slowly to reveal a homeowner sitting at a kitchen island, expression flat with recognition, not frustration. Cut to a clean, minimal product lock-up: the AllignX wordmark on white with the approved tagline set beneath it. No contractor imagery. No feature UI. Palette: warm neutral interiors, restrained and premium. No on-screen text beyond the lock-up.
